cases.question: What is the maximum size of one D1 database on Workers Paid?
cases.expectedAnswer: 10 GB.

cases.question: How large can one D1 database be on the Free plan?
How many bound parameters may a D1 query have?
Must I manually update a D1 index after changing rows?
cases.expectedAnswer: No. D1 updates indexes automatically when indexed rows change.

cases.question: How long is D1 Time Travel available on the Free plan?
cases.expectedAnswer: 7 days.

cases.question: Can a SQLite-backed Durable Object execute SQL queries?
cases.expectedAnswer: Yes, through its storage SQL API, including sql.exec().

cases.question: What is the storage limit per SQLite-backed Durable Object?
cases.expectedAnswer: 10 GB per object.

cases.question: How many Durable Object classes are allowed on Workers Paid?
cases.expectedAnswer: 500 per account.

cases.question: Does R2 provide read-after-write consistency for objects?
cases.expectedAnswer: Yes. Completed object writes are immediately visible globally on direct R2 reads.

cases.question: Are newly uploaded files instantly visible when downloaded?
cases.expectedAnswer: Direct R2 reads see a completed upload immediately; a cached custom domain can still serve stale content or a cached 404.

cases.question: Can a cached 404 remain after an object is uploaded to R2?
cases.expectedAnswer: Yes, on a custom domain with caching until the cache expires or is purged.

cases.question: What is the maximum size of one R2 object?
cases.expectedAnswer: 5 TiB per object, with the documented multipart upload limit slightly lower.

cases.question: How long can an R2 object key be?
cases.expectedAnswer: 1,024 bytes.

cases.question: Is an r2.dev public bucket endpoint intended for production traffic?
cases.expectedAnswer: No. It is for testing and has a variable rate limit; use a custom domain for production.

cases.question: What is the request body size limit for Workers on a Cloudflare Free account?
cases.expectedAnswer: 100 MB; the limit depends on the Cloudflare account plan.

cases.question: Is the Workers HTTP Basic Authentication example production ready?
cases.expectedAnswer: No. The sample warns it is not suitable for production; use HTTPS and consider Cloudflare Access.

cases.question: Does Workers Caching cache POST requests by default?
cases.expectedAnswer: No. Only GET and HEAD are cached; POST invokes the Worker.

cases.question: Do custom RPC methods use Workers Caching?
cases.expectedAnswer: No. Custom RPC methods bypass Workers Caching.

cases.question: Which period values does a Workers Rate Limiting binding support?
cases.expectedAnswer: 10 or 60 seconds.

cases.question: What is the default CPU time per HTTP request on Workers Paid?
cases.expectedAnswer: 30 seconds by default; it can be configured up to 5 minutes.

cases.question: How can I buy a domain from Cloudflare?
How does Cloudflare host domains?
cases.expectedAnswer: Ask whether the user means registration, DNS, Pages, Workers, or R2; the corpus only covers some custom-domain uses.

How many employees does Sellora have?
Can I register an emoji domain with Cloudflare Registrar?
